mismatches.digest_line: The core instructions behind Meta's Muse must be written by hand, with no part drafted by AI, under a rule Mona Sarantakos sets for her team.
mismatches.source_says: Transcript [44:58]: "there's actually been like this like funny trend recently where like our system prompt has to be handwritten. Like it has to be like you cannot use an AI to write a system prompt, any part of it... The behavioral spec needs to be handwritten." She calls it a team trend. She never says she set the rule.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Meta's Muse team now requires its system prompt and behavioural spec to be handwritten, with no part written by AI, says Mona Sarantakos.

mismatches.item: Data Driven Recruiter: The Hiring Safety Playbook
mismatches.digest_line: Luke Eaton's eight step hiring safety checklist, which he says a small TA team can get through in a week. Start by ending take-home tests that candidates must download and run on their own machine.
mismatches.source_says: The take-home rule is step 7 of 8 ("7. Make your own process look nothing like a scam: 'No take-homes as zip files or repos that candidates must run locally...'"). Step 1 is "Name your recruiters". The playbook never says to start with take-homes.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Luke Eaton's eight step hiring safety checklist, which he says a small TA team can get through in a week. One step: no take-home tests that candidates must download and run on their own machine.

mismatches.item: The Debrief: The Geography of Tech Hiring
mismatches.digest_line: Zapier is fully remote with just under 1,000 people in 42 countries, yet it now ranks countries for hiring instead of hiring anywhere.
mismatches.source_says: [13:58-14:58] "even at Zapier, we used to say we hire from anywhere, and now... we're saying, oh, but maybe like these places are better than these places because some of the labor laws or tax requirements..."; [26:44] "Get back to me again in like 3 months and I'll tell you like here's our tiered stack rank of where we want to go into." The ranking is still being worked out, not in place.
mismatches.suggested_fix: Zapier is fully remote with just under 1,000 people in 42 countries, yet it no longer hires from anywhere, judging some countries better than others on labour law and tax.

mismatches.item: TA Unboxed: How Do Candidates Know Your Recruiters Are Real?
mismatches.digest_line: Impostors reuse a genuine recruiter's name, branding and LinkedIn details and change only the contact address, so a polished signature or convincing profile is no proof for a candidate.
mismatches.source_says: "impostors can reuse a genuine recruiter's name, branding and LinkedIn details while changing the actual contact address." The source says "can", not that they always do, and does not say "only".
mismatches.suggested_fix: Impostors can reuse a genuine recruiter's name, branding and LinkedIn details while changing the contact address, so a polished signature or convincing profile is no proof for a candidate.

mismatches.item: Preview (AI & I: A New Vision for Human Work After Automation)
mismatches.digest_line: and Dan Shipper shows where Claude struggles to pick its own best answer.
mismatches.source_says: [14:20] "if Claude can give 400 answers at the same time, one of the things I'm going to say is in there, but it can't rank them... the thing that I say is only in the top 10% like 60% of the time." The test was whether Claude could pick out Shipper's real reply, not its "best" answer.
mismatches.suggested_fix: and Dan Shipper shows Claude struggling to pick his real reply out of its own guesses.
